tagline: Explain personal finances through the three spending baskets.
introduction: Help explore sponsor synthetic transactions through conversational questions, code-owned arithmetic, transaction-level evidence and explicit reserve assumptions. Distinguish mandatory regular, mandatory irregular and everyday spending. A banking connection or safe-to-spend guarantee is not included.
welcome: What would you like to understand or plan with S-Pankki? Choose a starter below, or share a small redacted example.

capabilities.title: Design S-Pankki challenge support
capabilities.description: Transaction-linked arithmetic oracle. Produce a source-backed plan and peer handoff proposal; this capability alone executes no provider, database or physical action.

source references, dependencies and explicitly unverified actions
